hypotheses.claim: A revision sustained across multiple lead checkpoints is more useful than a one-off late jump.
hypotheses.effect: persistent direction 96.2%, improvement 72.7%; one-off direction 81.0%, improvement 56.7%
hypotheses.product_update: Promote sustained multi-checkpoint revisions as a material-change signal.

hypotheses.claim: When at least 2 of 3 models revise in the same direction, that direction is useful for what-changed alerts.
hypotheses.product_update: Surface 2/3 models revised upward/downward as a directional change signal.

limitations: Lead-5, lead-3 and lead-1 checkpoints are proxies for persistent revision, not consecutive six-hour runs.
ERA5 is reanalysis rather than a local rain gauge.
A useful precipitation revision signal is not automatically a useful flood-impact alert.
